study: Fibonacci golden-pocket pullback, as practitioners trade it: in an intraday uptrend, after an impulse from the day's swing low to a new high, wait for a pullback into the 50%-61.8% retracement AND a bullish reaction candle there, buy the next open, stop below the 78.6% level, target the swing high. Does that beat the same bracket placed at random comparable minutes, and does the 50-61.8% zone do better than the same rule at other depths?
registered_at: 2026-10-23, before any script, feature or outcome (replaces an unreviewed first draft of the same day after the operator asked for the best-practice method)
origin: Operator 10/23 (CCI chart): draw the Fibonacci retracement from the recent lowest low to the highest high; when price is in the zone, open for a profit run. The operator asked for research on the most suitable method.

practitioner_consensus: trade it only WITH a trend: anchor from a clear swing low to the swing high of an up-move (no retracement in a sideways market); a common intraday trend filter is price above VWAP
the 50%-61.8% band ('golden pocket'; some extend to 65%) is the main entry zone; 38.2% for strong trends, 78.6% is the last line
do not buy the touch: the most common failure is entering before a reaction - wait for a bullish confirmation candle in the zone (hammer / bullish bar closing back up), enter at the next open
stop below the 78.6% level (or the swing low); target the prior swing high, or the 1.272 / 1.618 extensions for strong trends
method_research.evidence: A controlled academic test (Expert Systems with Applications: automatic identification of Fibonacci retracements in three equity markets) found that retracement zones are associated with bounces, but Fibonacci zones did NOT differ statistically from non-Fibonacci zones; other studies report gains vs buy-and-hold without a random-level control. Practitioner sources report no backtests. Hence this test compares the Fibonacci zone with other depths under the same rule.

prior: LOW (~5-10%): the controlled study finds no Fibonacci-specific effect; on these names buying dips after a signal lost 14-36 bp (10/14, 10/16), zone entries lost, near-support entries were least bad but negative (10/2), and the universe fades. The confirmation candle and VWAP filter are what practitioners say separates working from failing use, and they have not been tested together here.
data: Warehouse SIP 1-minute bars, the 400-name book-like sample ('indicator-hist-sample'), 2026-05-11 .. 2026-10-15 (110 sessions); halves A <= 2026-07-29 < B. Information: the desk's board names (decision_ledger arm rows, 09-10 .. 10-15) when in the warehouse. Confirmation (only after a PASS): warehouse_confirm (2026-01-14 .. 04-24), unchanged.
swing: Completed bars only. From 09:30: L = the lowest low so far; H = the highest high made after L (a new high moves H; a new low below L resets L and H). A swing QUALIFIES when H / L - 1 >= 2.0% and H was made at or after 09:45.

rule_primary_GP.zone: a bar after H whose LOW reaches into [H - 0.618 x R, H - 0.5 x R], R = H - L, with no close below H - 0.786 x R earlier in this pullback (else the swing is broken)
rule_primary_GP.trend_filter: the zone bar's close is above session VWAP (SIP bars, typical-price x volume from 09:30 through that bar)
rule_primary_GP.confirmation: a bullish reaction bar: the first bar at or after the zone touch (within 5 bars) that closes ABOVE its open and above the previous bar's high, with its low still >= H - 0.786 x R
rule_primary_GP.entry: the OPEN of the bar after the confirmation bar, if the decision bar is in 10:00 .. 15:15
rule_primary_GP.bracket: stop = a close below H - 0.786 x R (exit at the next bar's open); target = H (exit when a bar's high reaches H, filled at H, or at that bar's open if it gaps above); time stop = 30 bars (exit at the close); 5 bp round-trip cost
rule_primary_GP.limits: one trade per swing; at most 3 per name-day; no new entry while a trade in that name is open

comparisons.SHALLOW: the same rule with the zone [H - 0.382 x R, H - 0.236 x R]
comparisons.DEEP: the same rule with the zone [H - 0.786 x R, H - 0.70 x R] and the stop at a close below L (the swing low)
comparisons.NO_CONFIRM: GP zone, VWAP filter, but entry at the open after the zone-touch bar (no reaction candle)
comparisons.NO_VWAP: GP rule without the VWAP filter

control: RANDOM-BRACKET control (the order_block_gate range-trade design): for each GP trade, a seeded random minute of the same name-day in the same clock hour, at least 15 minutes from the trade, with a bullish bar (close > open and > previous high) and the close above VWAP, entered at the next open with the SAME percentage stop distance, SAME percentage target distance and the same 30-bar time stop (seed 'fib-gp-ctrl'). This isolates the Fibonacci location from the bracket shape, the bullish-bar trigger and the trend filter.
statistic: Per half: per day the mean over GP trades of (trade net - its control net); day-equal; day-clustered t (df = days - 1). The same for the comparisons (information except where named in the pass rule).
pass: In BOTH halves: GP minus control >= +5 bp with t >= 2.0; GP mean net (after 5 bp) > 0; FIBONACCI SPECIFICITY: GP minus control >= SHALLOW minus control and >= DEEP minus control (point estimates); dropping the 3 days and (separately) the 3 names with the largest share keeps GP minus control >= 0. FAIL: t <= -2 in a half, or the 97.5% upper bound < +5 bp in both halves. Otherwise UNDERPOWERED. A PASS is confirmed unchanged on warehouse_confirm before anything else, then a forward paper prereg; never a desk change by itself.
power: Outcome-blind count step: GP / SHALLOW / DEEP / NO_CONFIRM / NO_VWAP trade counts and days per half, controls found, and a projected MDE from the dispersion of control trades' net returns (control outcomes only). Floors per half: >= 300 GP trades and >= 20 days; else UNDERPOWERED.
information_only: win rate, target-hit / stop / time-stop shares, average hold
a 1.272 extension target instead of H
no_retuning: 2.0% swing, zone boundaries, 0.786 break, VWAP filter, the reaction-bar definition and its 5-bar window, the bracket, 5 bp, window, sample, halves and floors are fixed.
declared_deviations: SIP 1-minute bars (the live desk sees IEX)
bar-based fills (next open; target fills at H), no spread beyond the 5 bp cost
the book-like sample, not the desk's own entries
the bracket is the practitioners', not the desk's live exits

amended.when: 2026-10-23, before any script or data, after result-skeptic FIX FIRST (13 items).
changes: (1) SWING IDENTITY = its low L: a new high above H with the same L extends the same swing (H moves); ONE GP trade per swing (per L). A pullback whose CLOSE goes below H - 0.786 x R breaks the swing: no entry until a new high above H re-arms it (same L, new H).
(2) BAR ORDER: the zone test on bar t uses H, L and R built from bars BEFORE t; a bar whose high makes a new H is never a zone bar.

(3) TOUCH = the first bar after H whose low <= H - 0.5 x R (the zone's upper edge) and whose close >= H - 0.786 x R (a low that pierces 0.618 but stays above 0.786 counts as touching the zone). If no confirmation follows within the window, the swing re-arms only after a new H.

(4) REACTION WINDOW = the touch bar plus the next 4 bars (5 bars). The 0.786 close-break check runs on every bar from the touch through the confirmation bar. If the entry open is >= H the trade is skipped (counted). DEEP: its zone is [H - 0.786 x R, H - 0.70 x R], the break is a close below L, and its stop is a close below L.
(5) VWAP filter on the CONFIRMATION bar (its close > session VWAP through that bar), for GP and the control alike.
(6) TARGET FILL requires a bar high >= target + $0.01 (not equal highs), for GP and the control alike; filled at the target (or at the bar's open if it opens above the target).

(7) BRACKET: checks start with the entry bar (its high / low / close count); the time stop is 30 CLOCK minutes from the entry bar (exit at the close of the last bar at or before entry + 29 min); if a bar both reaches the target and closes below the stop, the TARGET wins; a missing-bar gap > 5 minutes inside a hold exits at the next available bar's open (counted).
(8) PRICE FLOOR: the entry bar's open >= $10 (the warehouse screen already needs a prior close >= $10); $20 as information. Net printed at 3, 5, 10 and 20 bp; 5 bp binding.

(9) CONTROL: the same 10:00-15:15 decision window and 30-minute room; seed sha256(sym|day|minute|'fib-gp-ctrl') per trade; no fallback (the share of trades with no control is reported); information control: the same pullback rule at a random depth band of width 0.118 between 0.236 and 0.786 outside 0.5-0.618 (seeded), the academic paper's design.

(10) SPECIFICITY: day-clustered (GP - control) minus (SHALLOW - control) and minus (DEEP - control), each >= 0 with t >= 1.0 in both halves, is required for a PASS to be called Fibonacci-specific; without it a PASS is reported as 'pullback edge, not Fibonacci-specific'.

(11) POWER: the MDE uses the SD of (control - a second independent control, seed tag 'fib-gp-ctrl2') per day; the count step counts trades WITHOUT the one-open-trade rule (it needs exit times); that rule applies at scoring and the trade count after it is reported.

(12) The four comparisons, the random-depth control, swing buckets, time of day, the board subset and the 1.272 target are INFORMATION ONLY and cannot promote anything; a lead from them needs a new prereg.
(13) This prereg is committed (hash recorded in the script output) before the count step.
